verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a payments API platform like EBANX, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes JWS request signing with an RSA key pair, which is an authentication method rather than permission scoping. Nothing shows the ability to issue restricted, least-privilege, or per-agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
